testOnly.passkeys: soft passkeys per person (tests/helpers/soft-passkey.mjs) behind navigator.credentials; real adapter verification
testOnly.turnstile: third-party stand-in for Cloudflare Turnstile (widget script and siteverify), tokens bound to host and action, single use
testOnly.tls: per-run local CA; browsers ignore certificate errors; servers trust only the run CA
testOnly.network: DNS and socket replaced at the providers' injection seams; screening unchanged
testOnly.addresses: each person browses through their own proxy port carrying a seeded address, passed to providers in the operator trusted client-IP header (TRUSTED_CLIENT_IP_HEADER)
testOnly.clock: real time (see gaps: a frozen browser clock breaks DPoP proof iat checks against real-time providers)

caveat: Self-consistency, not interoperability: every provider here shares authors.
